title: Skilled Trades & Vocational
tagline: ITI and NSDC certifications: electrician, AC tech, CNC operator, solar PV, beautician — accessible, well-paying, often overlooked.
overview: Skilled trades are the most under-represented career path in middle-class Indian families' planning, despite being among the fastest routes to ₹15,000-30,000/month income within 1-2 years and lifelong self-employment. The 2026 reality: ITI government tuition is ₹1,000-5,000/year (under ₹10,000 for full course); on March 2 2026 the DGT mandated 150 hours of On-the-Job Training as part of every NCVT trade. Welders, electricians, diesel mechanics, and AC/refrigeration technicians are the highest-paying trades, with Gulf demand routinely paying ₹50,000-1,00,000/month for certified workers. NSDC short courses (Skill India) under MSDE supplement the ITI ecosystem with sector-specific micro-certifications. The hidden gem: solar PV technicians and EV technicians are growing 20%+ annually under PM-KUSUM and FAME-II push.
key_insights: Government ITI total fees often under ₹10,000 — the lowest legitimate skill-acquisition cost in any Indian career path; SC/ST students often free.
Certified welders (NCVT-affiliated) routinely earn ₹50K-1L/month in Gulf countries — one of the fastest middle-income migration routes from India.
Solar PV technician and EV technician trades are growing 20%+ annually post FAME-II and PM-KUSUM; NSDC adding new courses every year.
ITI graduates have lateral-entry to second year of Polytechnic Diploma — earn during ITI, save, then upgrade to engineering technician roles at ₹35-45K/month govt JE pay.
PSU recruitment (Railways RRB, BHEL, NTPC, SAIL, Defence DRDO) reserves a large share for ITI/NCVT-certified candidates — far higher hiring volume than B.Tech graduates.

sub_paths.name: Electrician (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 2-year NCVT trade — electrical wiring, transmission lines, machinery. Highest-demand trade with PSU + private + Gulf options.
sub_paths.qualification: ITI Electrician Trade Certificate (NCVT/SCVT) → National Trade Certificate (NTC) after AITT exam
sub_paths.entrance_exam: State ITI entrance / merit-based admission on 10th marks
top_institutions: Maharashtra State Council of Vocational Training (govt)
scholarships: state ITI free schemes for reserved categories
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf demand strong (UAE, Saudi, Qatar) — certified electricians earn ₹50K-1L/month. Australia/Canada via skilled migration after additional A-grade certification.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Wiring installation at construction sites, machinery maintenance in factories, fault-finding and repair, occasional night-shift emergency work. Manual labour with safety gear.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee Electrician → Skilled Electrician → Foreman → Supervisor / contractor running own crew. PSU route via Railways/state SEBs at ₹18-30K start.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.2-2.4 LPA (₹10-20K/month) / Mid: 2.5-4.5 LPA / Senior (self-employed contractor): 5-15 LPA. Note: State SEB lineman ₹18-30K/month govt; Gulf certified ₹50K-1L/month. Source: NCVT MIS, DGT, Glassdoor 2026.

sub_paths.name: Welder (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 1-2 year NCVT trade — arc, MIG, TIG welding. Very high demand in shipbuilding, pipeline, construction; one of the highest Gulf-pay trades.
sub_paths.qualification: ITI Welder Trade Certificate + AWS / 3G / 6G welder certifications
duration: 1 year (NCVT) + advanced specialty certs 3-6 mo each
top_institutions: Larsen & Toubro Construction Skills Training Inst (semi-govt CSR)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Strongest Gulf trade — UAE/Saudi/Qatar shipyards and pipelines pay ₹60K-1.2L/month for 6G certified welders. Australia/Canada via skilled migration.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Welding fabrication on shop floor, site work in pipelines/shipyards. Heavy PPE required (helmet, gloves, fire-resistant clothing). Physically demanding.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Welder → Specialty Welder (6G, TIG) → Welding Inspector (CSWIP/AWS-CWI cert). Inspector roles 8-15 LPA; supervisor 5-10 LPA.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.5-3 LPA (₹12-25K/month) / Mid: 3-7 LPA / Senior (Inspector/abroad): 8-15 LPA. Note: Gulf specialty welders ₹60K-1.2L/month tax-free; CSWIP-certified domestic 8-12L. Source: NCVT, AWS India.

sub_paths.name: Fitter (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 2-year NCVT trade — mechanical fitting, assembly, machine maintenance in manufacturing/automotive.
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf manufacturing/petrochem sector hires fitters at ₹45-70K/month. Limited non-Gulf pathways without bridging quals.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Component assembly, dimension measurement, machine maintenance and dismantling, blueprint reading. Shop floor work in automotive/manufacturing plants.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Fitter → Charge Hand → Foreman. Maruti/Tata/Mahindra hire fitters extensively; PSU route via SAIL/BHEL pays better.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.4-2.6 LPA / Mid: 3-5 LPA / Senior: 5-12 LPA. Note: Maruti/Tata fitter 2-4L start; PSU SAIL/BHEL via Apprentice exam 3-4.5L. Source: NCVT, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Diesel Mechanic / Automotive Mechanic (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 1-2 year NCVT trade — engine repair, vehicle maintenance, heavy machinery. Strong demand in logistics, mining, transport.
sub_paths.qualification: ITI Mechanic Diesel / Mechanic Motor Vehicle Trade Certificate
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf transport/logistics hire diesel mechanics at ₹50-80K/month. Australia heavy-vehicle technician pathway via TAFE bridges.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Engine diagnostics, vehicle servicing, breakdown repair, fleet maintenance for trucking firms or in OEM dealerships.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Mechanic → Service Advisor → Workshop Manager. Self-employed garage owners earn ₹40K-1L/month routinely after 5-10 yrs.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.4-2.6 LPA / Mid: 3-6 LPA / Senior (workshop owner): 6-15 LPA. Note: Authorized OEM dealerships 2.5-4.5L start; logistics firms (TCI, GATI) higher; Gulf 6-10L. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: AC / Refrigeration Technician (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 1-2 year NCVT trade — split AC, central HVAC, commercial refrigeration installation and repair. Booming demand in tier-2/3 cities.
sub_paths.qualification: ITI Mechanic Refrigeration & AC (R&AC) Trade Certificate
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf HVAC sector massive demand — UAE/Saudi/Qatar pay ₹50-90K/month for HVAC technicians. Singapore service-industry similar.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Customer-site AC installation/servicing, freon refilling, fault diagnosis, occasional commercial site work (malls, offices). Lots of travel within city.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Technician → Senior Technician → Service Manager / Self-employed. Shop owners with 3-5 staff earn ₹40K-1.5L/month.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.5-3 LPA / Mid: 3-6 LPA / Senior (self-employed): 6-15 LPA. Note: Brand-authorised technicians (Daikin, LG) 2.5-5L; Gulf 6-12L. Source: AmbitionBox, NCVT.

sub_paths.name: Plumber (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 1-year NCVT trade — water supply, sanitary fixtures, drainage, pipe-fitting. Heavy demand in real-estate / urban housing growth.
top_institutions: Indian Plumbing Skills Council Delhi (semi-govt, NSDC affiliated)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf real-estate boom hires Indian plumbers at ₹40-70K/month. UK/Australia plumber pathways possible after additional certifications (NVQ, etc).
sub_paths.day_in_life: Site work in residential/commercial buildings, repair calls in homes, drain cleaning, fixture installation. Self-employed plumbers manage own schedule.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Plumber → Master Plumber → Self-employed contractor. Self-employed plumbers in metros earn ₹30-80K/month routinely.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.2-2.4 LPA / Mid: 2.5-5 LPA / Senior (self-employed): 5-12 LPA. Note: Self-employment is the high-pay route; salaried plumber pay caps lower. Source: AmbitionBox, IPA.

sub_paths.name: Carpenter (ITI / NSDC)
sub_paths.description: 1-year NCVT trade — wooden furniture, modular interiors, finish carpentry, site joinery work.
sub_paths.qualification: ITI Carpenter Trade Certificate / NSDC Furniture & Fittings short course
top_institutions: Furniture & Fittings Skill Council Delhi (semi-govt, NSDC SSC)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf and Africa real-estate demand for finish carpenters; Indian craftsmen prized for traditional woodwork (UAE-based hotels, Saudi palaces).
sub_paths.day_in_life: Workshop fabrication of furniture, on-site interior installation, repair and refinishing work. Mix of workshop and customer-site work.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Carpenter → Master Craftsman → Self-employed / shop owner. Modular kitchen/wardrobe specialists in metros earn well.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.2-2.4 LPA / Mid: 2.5-5 LPA / Senior (self-employed): 5-15 LPA. Note: Modular kitchen specialists ₹30K-1L/month; site labourer end ₹10-15K/month. Source: NSDC, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Mason / Construction Skills (NSDC)
sub_paths.description: Short-duration NSDC course in masonry, bricklaying, plastering, formwork — backbone of India's construction sector.
sub_paths.entrance_exam: Direct enrollment at NSDC training partners
sub_paths.govt_fees: Free under PMKVY for eligible candidates
top_institutions: Construction Skill Development Council India (CSDCI, semi-govt SSC)
L&T Construction Skills Training Inst (firm CSR)
RPL (Recognition of Prior Learning) certifications under PMKVY
scholarships: PMKVY full course fee covered + ₹500-1,500 monthly stipend
NREGA construction training in some states
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf construction labour pathway hires Indian masons at ₹35-60K/month. UAE/Saudi mega-projects (NEOM, Expo) prized destinations.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Construction-site brick laying, plastering, RCC formwork, finishing. Physically intensive outdoor work; site rotations.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Mason → Mistry/Foreman → Subcontractor. Subcontractors with crews of 10-30 workers earn ₹50K-3L/month.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.2-2.4 LPA / Mid: 2.4-4.5 LPA / Senior (subcontractor): 4-12 LPA. Note: Daily-wage masons ₹500-1,200/day; certified PMKVY 2.5-4L start; Gulf labour 4-8L. Source: NSDC, CSDCI.

sub_paths.name: CNC Operator / Machinist (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 2-year NCVT trade — Computer Numerical Control machine programming and operation; high-precision manufacturing.
sub_paths.qualification: ITI CNC Operator / Machinist Trade Certificate
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf precision-mfg sector hires CNC operators at ₹50-80K/month. Germany Ausbildung dual-vocational pathway possible for top performers.
sub_paths.day_in_life: CNC programming/operation in factories, dimension QA, tool changes, basic G-code work. Cleaner factory conditions than welding/fitting trades.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → CNC Operator → CNC Programmer → Production Supervisor. CAD/CAM upskill leads to design-engineer track at ₹6-12L.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.8-3.6 LPA / Mid: 3.5-7 LPA / Senior (programmer): 6-14 LPA. Note: Auto components (Bosch, ZF) 3-5L start; aerospace/defence CNC higher. Source: AmbitionBox, NCVT.

sub_paths.name: Turner (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 2-year NCVT trade — lathe operation for cylindrical metal work; precision turning, threading, knurling.
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf manufacturing hires turners at ₹45-65K/month; less common than welder/fitter migration.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Lathe machine operation in workshop/factory, precision dimension work, blueprint reading. Indoor shop work; cleaner than welder trade.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Skilled Turner → Charge Hand → Senior Operator. PSU apprentice → permanent absorption common in BHEL/SAIL.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.4-2.6 LPA / Mid: 3-5 LPA / Senior: 5-10 LPA. Note: PSU permanent post 3.5-5L; private precision turning 2.5-4L; Gulf 5-8L. Source: NCVT, BHEL.

sub_paths.name: Electronics Mechanic (ITI)
sub_paths.description: 2-year NCVT trade — electronics assembly, repair of consumer electronics, telecom equipment, instrumentation.
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf electronics service hiring at ₹40-65K/month; SE Asia (Singapore, Malaysia) electronics-mfg sector also.
sub_paths.day_in_life: PCB-level repair, soldering, test instrument operation, customer-site service calls. Indoor workshop and field-call mix.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Service Technician → Senior Tech → Service Manager / Self-employed. Mobile/laptop repair entrepreneurs earn well.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.4-2.6 LPA / Mid: 3-5.5 LPA / Senior: 5-12 LPA. Note: Authorized service centres (Samsung, LG, Apple) 2.5-4L; mobile repair shops self-employed 3-10L. Source: AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Solar PV Technician (NSDC)
sub_paths.description: Short-duration NSDC course — solar panel installation, maintenance, on-grid/off-grid systems. Fastest-growing trade post-PM-KUSUM.
sub_paths.qualification: NCVT-NSDC Solar PV Installer (Suryamitra programme) / Solar Technician cert
sub_paths.govt_fees: Free under Suryamitra Skill Development scheme
top_institutions: National Institute of Solar Energy Gurugram (govt, MNRE)
Skill Council for Green Jobs Delhi (semi-govt)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf and African solar projects increasingly hire Indian-trained technicians; Saudi 'Vision 2030' solar push paying ₹50-80K/month.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Rooftop installation work (residential and commercial), wiring inverters, panel cleaning/maintenance, grid-connection testing. Outdoor hands-on work.
sub_paths.growth_path: Suryamitra → Senior Technician → Project Coordinator → Site Engineer (with B.Tech upskill). Solar EPC firms (Tata Power, Adani, Vikram Solar) hire heavily.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.5-3 LPA / Mid: 3-6 LPA / Senior: 6-12 LPA. Note: Tata/Adani solar EPC 3-5L; rooftop installer entrepreneurs 5-15L. Source: NSDC, MNRE Suryamitra.

sub_paths.name: Beautician / Cosmetology (NSDC / ITI)
sub_paths.description: Short-duration NSDC/B&WSSC certification — hair, skin, nail care; salon work or self-employment. Largely female-dominated trade with strong demand.
sub_paths.qualification: NSDC Beauty & Wellness Council (B&WSSC) certified Beautician / Cosmetology Diploma
sub_paths.govt_fees: Free under PMKVY for eligible candidates
sub_paths.private_fees: VLCC, Lakme, Shahnaz Husain academies 30,000-2 lakh
top_institutions: VLCC Institute of Beauty & Nutrition (private, India network)
Govt ITIs - Beauty & Hair Care trade (govt)
Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council Delhi (semi-govt, NSDC SSC)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf salon industry heavy hiring; Indian beauticians at UAE/Saudi salons earn ₹50-80K/month + tips. Spa/cruise-line industry global.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Salon-based hair styling, facials, threading, makeup; self-employed beauticians do home visits. Long standing hours.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Beautician → Senior Stylist → Salon Owner / Bridal Specialist. Bridal makeup artists in metros earn ₹15K-1L per assignment.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.2-3 LPA / Mid: 3-7 LPA / Senior (salon owner / bridal): 6-25 LPA. Note: Bridal makeup artists in tier-1 cities earn premium; chain salons (Lakme, Naturals) 2-4L start. Source: NSDC B&WSSC, AmbitionBox.

sub_paths.name: Chef / Cook / Bakery (NSDC / IHM)
sub_paths.description: Diploma/short certification — commercial kitchens, hotel F&B, bakery confectionery, cloud kitchens. India's restaurant sector growing 15%+ yearly.
sub_paths.min_12th_percent: 10th pass for diploma; 12th for IHM craft courses
sub_paths.qualification: Craftsmanship Cook / Bakery diploma / NSDC F&B cert
sub_paths.entrance_exam: IHM craft entrance; direct enrollment for short courses
sub_paths.govt_fees: IHM Mumbai/Delhi craft 50,000-1.5 lakh total; FCI Bakery 30,000-80,000
sub_paths.private_fees: IICA/Cordon Bleu/IHM Aurangabad 1.5-6 lakh; private culinary 1-4 lakh
top_institutions: IICA Indian Inst of Culinary Arts (private)
Tourism & Hospitality Skill Council Delhi (semi-govt, NSDC)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf hotels, cruise ships, UK/Australia restaurant industry hire heavily — Indian-trained chefs in Dubai/Doha earn ₹50K-1.5L/month.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Hotel/restaurant kitchen prep, station-by-station service, opening/closing duties; bakery early-morning shifts.
sub_paths.growth_path: Commis Chef → Demi Chef → Chef de Partie → Sous Chef → Executive Chef → Director of F&B. Cloud-kitchen and food-startup founder route also growing.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.5-3.5 LPA / Mid: 4-10 LPA / Senior (Exec Chef / restaurant owner): 12-50 LPA. Note: 5-star chefs (Taj, Oberoi) 6-15L mid-career; cruise ships USD 1500-3000/mo. Source: AmbitionBox, IHM placements.

sub_paths.name: Tailor / Garment Maker (NSDC / ITI)
sub_paths.description: ITI Sewing Technology / NSDC garment-construction trade — tailoring, alterations, garment factory line work, boutique work.
sub_paths.qualification: ITI Sewing Tech / Apparel Made-Ups & Home Furnishing (AMH) Trade Cert / ATDC garment cert
top_institutions: Apparel Training & Design Centre (ATDC) - 200+ centres (semi-govt, AEPC)
Apparel Made-Ups & Home Furnishings Sector Skill Council (semi-govt, NSDC SSC)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Bangladesh/Vietnam/Sri Lanka garment-factory supervisor roles for experienced Indian tailors. Some boutique pathways to UAE.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Garment factory line operation OR boutique custom tailoring OR own shop. Sewing machine operation, pattern cutting, finishing.
sub_paths.growth_path: Trainee → Operator → Line Lead → Floor Supervisor / Boutique Owner. Boutique designers serving urban customers earn well.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.2-2.4 LPA / Mid: 2.5-5 LPA / Senior (boutique owner): 5-15 LPA. Note: Garment factory line 1.2-2L; bespoke tailoring (urban) 4-12L; bridal boutique premium. Source: ATDC, AEPC.

sub_paths.name: Retail Associate / Sales Skills (NSDC RASCI)
sub_paths.description: Short-duration NSDC Retailers Association SSC training — store associate, customer service, inventory mgmt. Massive volume hiring.
sub_paths.qualification: RASCI (Retailers Association Skill Council of India) certification
top_institutions: Retailers Association Skill Council of India (RASCI) - NSDC SSC (semi-govt)
Future Group Reliance Retail in-house training (firm)
Big Bazaar Internal Training Programmes (firm; legacy)
sub_paths.abroad_pathways: Gulf retail hires Indian-trained staff at ₹35-50K/month; Singapore/Malaysia retail also.
sub_paths.day_in_life: Customer service on shop floor, billing, inventory, visual merchandising. Long standing hours; weekends and evenings busy.
sub_paths.growth_path: Sales Associate → Senior Associate → Section Lead → Store Manager → Area Manager. Retail mgmt MBA pathway viable for top performers.
sub_paths.salary_bands: Fresher: 1.5-2.4 LPA / Mid: 2.5-5 LPA / Senior (Store Manager): 5-12 LPA. Note: Reliance/DMart/Croma 1.8-3L start; mall retail 2-3L; performance incentives common. Source: AmbitionBox, RASCI.

confidence_notes: Govt ITI fees verified via state ITI directorates and DGT MIS portal; ₹1,000-5,000/year is the typical range with some variation by state.
Salary data for ITI trades is sparse on AmbitionBox/Glassdoor since employers are smaller and informal; ranges drawn from NCVT placement disclosures, OEM training centre data, and field reports.
DGT 2026 OJT mandate (150 hours, March 2 2026) verified from DGT notifications.
Solar PV Technician confidence 'medium' — Suryamitra figures from MNRE; private-sector salary spread is wide and rapidly changing.
Carpenter, Mason, Tailor confidence 'medium' — informal sector pay variability is high; ranges should be treated as central tendency with significant individual variation.
Gulf-pay figures verified through migrant-worker recruitment agency data; tax-free status applies if NRI status met.
